models.final_message:
Created both submission files in `/logs/artifacts/`:

- `robot.xml` — compact 2020-profile chassis, rigidly mounted 10 kg battery, direct-child `arm_mount_site`, preserved mecanum wheel assemblies, and the preview Panda subtree.
- `controller.py` — deterministic wheel-position feedback and staged arm IK for shelf entry and target holding.

`scene.xml` compiles in MuJoCo 3.5.0. I verified the required wheel/roller names and mount-site parent, and ran a Panda simulation sanity check. I did not run the full three-arm, 12-target evaluation.

import numpy as np
import mujoco


class Controller:
    def reset(self, context, seed):
        self.context = context
        self.model = mujoco.MjModel.from_binary_path(context['model_file'])
        self.data = mujoco.MjData(self.model)
        self.actuator_names = list(context['actuator_names'])
        self.arm_actuator_names = list(context['arm_actuator_names'])
        self.wheel_actuator_names = list(context['wheel_actuator_names'])
        self.act_ids = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(self.actuator_names)}
        self.site_id = mujoco.mj_name2id(self.model, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_SITE, context['ee_site'])
        self.joint_ids = [mujoco.mj_name2id(self.model, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_JOINT, n)
                          for n in context['arm_joint_names']]
        self.qadr = [int(self.model.jnt_qposadr[j]) for j in self.joint_ids]
        self.dadr = [int(self.model.jnt_dofadr[j]) for j in self.joint_ids]
        self.base_joint = mujoco.mj_name2id(self.model, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_JOINT, context['base_joint'])
        self.base_qadr = int(self.model.jnt_qposadr[self.base_joint])
        self.qinit = np.asarray(context['qpos'], dtype=float)
        self.target = np.asarray(context['target'], dtype=float)
        self.arm = context['arm']
        self.limits = np.asarray([self.model.jnt_range[j] for j in self.joint_ids])
        self.arm_ctrl_indices = [self.act_ids[n] for n in self.arm_actuator_names]
        self.wheel_indices = [self.act_ids[n] for n in self.wheel_actuator_names]
        self.initial_arm = self.qinit[self.qadr].copy()
        # Plan in the fixed world frame from the intended staging pose.
        self.data.qpos[:] = self.qinit
        self.data.qpos[self.base_qadr:self.base_qadr + 7] = [-0.10, 0.0, 0.08, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
        mujoco.mj_forward(self.model, self.data)
        self.path = [self._ik(p, self.initial_arm) for p in (
            np.array([0.20, self.target[1], self.target[2] + 0.14]),
            np.array([0.34, self.target[1], self.target[2] + 0.14]),
            self.target.copy())]
        self.stage_times = [4.0, 8.0, 13.0]

    def _ik(self, goal, seed):
        q = np.asarray(seed, dtype=float).copy()
        jacp = np.zeros((3, self.model.nv))
        jacr = np.zeros((3, self.model.nv))
        for _ in range(180):
            self.data.qpos[self.qadr] = q
            mujoco.mj_forward(self.model, self.data)
            error = goal - self.data.site_xpos[self.site_id]
            if np.linalg.norm(error) < 0.008:
                break
            mujoco.mj_jacSite(self.model, self.data, jacp, jacr, self.site_id)
            jac = jacp[:, self.dadr]
            dq = jac.T @ np.linalg.solve(jac @ jac.T + 0.012 * np.eye(3), error)
            scale = max(1.0, np.max(np.abs(dq)) / 0.12)
            q = np.clip(q + dq / scale, self.limits[:, 0] + 0.015, self.limits[:, 1] - 0.015)
        return q

    def act(self, observation):
        t = float(observation['time'])
        qpos = np.asarray(observation['qpos'], dtype=float)
        controls = np.asarray(observation['ctrl'], dtype=float).copy()
        x = qpos[self.base_qadr]
        # All four wheels use the same sign for forward motion in this X layout.
        drive = -4.0 if x < -0.105 and t < 5.0 else 0.0
        for idx in self.wheel_indices:
            controls[idx] = drive
        if t < self.stage_times[0]:
            desired = self.initial_arm
        elif t < self.stage_times[1]:
            u = (t - self.stage_times[0]) / (self.stage_times[1] - self.stage_times[0])
            desired = self.initial_arm * (1.0 - u) + self.path[0] * u
        elif t < self.stage_times[2]:
            u = (t - self.stage_times[1]) / (self.stage_times[2] - self.stage_times[1])
            desired = self.path[0] * (1.0 - u) + self.path[1] * u
        else:
            desired = self.path[2]
        for i, idx in enumerate(self.arm_ctrl_indices):
            controls[idx] = float(desired[i])
        return controls.tolist()


def make_controller():
    return Controller()

        self.arm_ctrl_indices = [self.act_ids[n] for n in self.arm_actuator_names]
        self.wheel_indices = [self.act_ids[n] for n in self.wheel_actuator_names]
        self.initial_arm = self.qinit[self.qadr].copy()
        # Plan in the fixed world frame from the intended staging pose.
        self.data.qpos[:] = self.qinit
        self.data.qpos[self.base_qadr:self.base_qadr + 7] = [-0.10, 0.0, 0.08, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
        mujoco.mj_forward(self.model, self.data)
        self.path = [self._ik(p, self.initial_arm) for p in (
            np.array([0.20, self.target[1], self.target[2] + 0.14]),
            np.array([0.34, self.target[1], self.target[2] + 0.14]),
            self.target.copy())]
        self.stage_times = [4.0, 8.0, 13.0]

    def _ik(self, goal, seed):
        q = np.asarray(seed, dtype=float).copy()
        jacp = np.zeros((3, self.model.nv))
        jacr = np.zeros((3, self.model.nv))
        for _ in range(180):
            self.data.qpos[self.qadr] = q
            mujoco.mj_forward(self.model, self.data)
            error = goal - self.data.site_xpos[self.site_id]
            if np.linalg.norm(error) < 0.008:
                break
            mujoco.mj_jacSite(self.model, self.data, jacp, jacr, self.site_id)
            jac = jacp[:, self.dadr]
            dq = jac.T @ np.linalg.solve(jac @ jac.T + 0.012 * np.eye(3), error)
            scale = max(1.0, np.max(np.abs(dq)) / 0.12)
            q = np.clip(q + dq / scale, self.limits[:, 0] + 0.015, self.limits[:, 1] - 0.015)
        return q

    def act(self, observation):
        t = float(observation['time'])
        qpos = np.asarray(observation['qpos'], dtype=float)
        controls = np.asarray(observation['ctrl'], dtype=float).copy()
        x = qpos[self.base_qadr]
        # All four wheels use the same sign for forward motion in this X layout.
        drive = -4.0 if x < -0.105 and t < 5.0 else 0.0
        for idx in self.wheel_indices:
            controls[idx] = drive
        if t < self.stage_times[0]:
            desired = self.initial_arm
        elif t < self.stage_times[1]:
            u = (t - self.stage_times[0]) / (self.stage_times[1] - self.stage_times[0])
            desired = self.initial_arm * (1.0 - u) + self.path[0] * u
        elif t < self.stage_times[2]:
            u = (t - self.stage_times[1]) / (self.stage_times[2] - self.stage_times[1])
            desired = self.path[0] * (1.0 - u) + self.path[1] * u
        else:
            desired = self.path[2]
        for i, idx in enumerate(self.arm_ctrl_indices):
            controls[idx] = float(desired[i])
        return controls.tolist()


def make_controller():
    return Controller()

    addresses=model.jnt_qposadr[joint_ids]
    data.qpos[addresses]=INITIAL[arm]
    data.ctrl[4:]=INITIAL[arm]
    mujoco.mj_forward(model,data)
    return model,data,joint_ids,addresses

import os

import numpy as np
import mujoco
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from scipy.spatial import ConvexHull


class Controller:
    def reset(self, context, seed):
        self.model = mujoco.MjModel.from_binary_path(context['model_file'])
        self.data = mujoco.MjData(self.model)
        self.data.qpos[:] = context['qpos']
        self.data.qvel[:] = context['qvel']
        self.initial = np.array(context['qpos'], dtype=float)
        self.controls = np.array(context['ctrl'], dtype=float)
        self.arm = context['arm']
        self.target = np.array(context['target'], dtype=float)
        self.aim = self.target.copy()
        self.aim[0] -= .022
        if self.target[2]<.5:
            self.aim[2] += .015
        self.arm_ids = np.array([self.model.actuator(name).id for name in context['arm_actuator_names']])
        self.wheel_ids = np.array([self.model.actuator(name).id for name in context['wheel_actuator_names']])
        joint_ids = np.array([self.model.joint(name).id for name in context['arm_joint_names']])
        self.addresses = self.model.jnt_qposadr[joint_ids]
        self.dofs = self.model.jnt_dofadr[joint_ids]
        self.ee = self.model.site(context['ee_site']).id
        base_joint = self.model.joint(context['base_joint']).id
        self.base_adr = self.model.jnt_qposadr[base_joint]
        self.base_dof = self.model.jnt_dofadr[base_joint]
        self.base_body = self.model.jnt_bodyid[base_joint]
        self.qstart = self.initial[self.addresses].copy()
        mujoco.mj_forward(self.model,self.data)
        root_body = self.model.body_parentid[self.model.jnt_bodyid[joint_ids[0]]]
        relative_rotation = self.data.xmat[self.base_body].reshape(3,3).T@self.data.xmat[root_body].reshape(3,3)
        root_yaw = np.arctan2(relative_rotation[1,0],relative_rotation[0,0])
        self.ur_seed_offset = np.arctan2(np.sin(np.pi-root_yaw),np.cos(np.pi-root_yaw))
        self.lower = np.maximum(self.model.jnt_range[joint_ids, 0], self.model.actuator_ctrlrange[self.arm_ids, 0]) + .015
        self.upper = np.minimum(self.model.jnt_range[joint_ids, 1], self.model.actuator_ctrlrange[self.arm_ids, 1]) - .015
        self.shelf = [index for index in range(self.model.ngeom) if self.model.geom(index).name.startswith('pod_')]
        arm_bodies = set(self.model.jnt_bodyid[joint_ids].tolist())
        descendants = set(arm_bodies)
        for body in range(1, self.model.nbody):
            if self.model.body_parentid[body] in descendants:
                descendants.add(body)
        self.moving = [index for index in range(self.model.ngeom) if self.model.geom_contype[index] and (self.model.geom_bodyid[index] in descendants or self.model.geom(index).name.startswith('arm_') or self.model.body(self.model.geom_bodyid[index]).name.startswith('arm_') or 'payload' in self.model.geom(index).name)]
        samples = []
        radii = []
        sample_geoms = []
        self.sample_starts = []
        for geom in self.moving:
            self.sample_starts.append(len(samples))
            shape = self.model.geom_type[geom]
            size = self.model.geom_size[geom]
            if shape == mujoco.mjtGeom.mjGEOM_MESH:
                mesh = self.model.geom_dataid[geom]
                start = self.model.mesh_vertadr[mesh]
                vertices = self.model.mesh_vert[start:start+self.model.mesh_vertnum[mesh]].astype(float)
                _, indices = np.unique(np.round(vertices/.02), axis=0, return_index=True)
                surface = vertices[indices]
                hull = ConvexHull(vertices)
                axes = [np.arange(vertices[:,axis].min(), vertices[:,axis].max()+.0175, .035) for axis in range(3)]
                grid = np.stack(np.meshgrid(*axes, indexing='ij'), axis=-1).reshape(-1, 3)
                grid = grid[np.max(grid@hull.equations[:,:3].T+hull.equations[:,3], axis=1) <= .002]
                points = np.r_[surface, grid]
                radius = np.r_[np.full(len(surface), .013), np.full(len(grid), .021)]
            elif shape == mujoco.mjtGeom.mjGEOM_CAPSULE:
                points = np.zeros((17, 3))
                points[:, 2] = np.linspace(-size[1], size[1], 17)
                radius = np.full(17, size[0]+.002)
            elif shape == mujoco.mjtGeom.mjGEOM_CYLINDER:
                points = np.zeros((1, 3))
                radius = np.array([np.hypot(size[0],size[1])])
            else:
                points = np.zeros((1, 3))
                radius = np.array([size[0]])
            samples.extend(points)
            radii.extend(radius)
            sample_geoms.extend([geom]*len(points))
        self.samples = np.array(samples)
        self.radii = np.array(radii)
        self.sample_geoms = np.array(sample_geoms)
        self.moving_set = set(self.moving)
        self.shelf_set = set(self.shelf)
        self.jacobian = np.zeros((3, self.model.nv))
        self.rot_jacobian = np.zeros((3, self.model.nv))
        self.plan(seed)
        self.last_wheels = np.zeros(4)
        self.travel_started = False

    def plan(self, seed):
        count = len(self.addresses)
        desired = self.aim.copy()
        lower = np.r_[self.lower, -.12, -.55]
        upper = np.r_[self.upper, .105, .55]
        nominal = np.r_[self.qstart, .085, self.target[1]]
        reference = nominal.copy()
        self.data.qvel[:] = 0
        panel_sizes = self.model.geom_size[self.shelf].copy()
        panel_positions = self.model.geom_pos[self.shelf].copy()
        panel_sizes[:, 0] += .4
        panel_positions[:, 0] += .4
        required_clearance = np.full(len(self.shelf),.016)
        if self.target[2]<.5:
            for index,panel in enumerate(self.shelf):
                if self.model.geom(panel).name=='pod_plate_0':
                    required_clearance[index] = .04

        def residual(configuration):
            self.data.qpos[:] = self.initial
            self.data.qpos[self.addresses] = configuration[:count]
            self.data.qpos[self.base_adr:self.base_adr+2] = configuration[count:]
            mujoco.mj_forward(self.model, self.data)
            position = self.data.site_xpos[self.ee]
            normal = self.data.site_xmat[self.ee].reshape(3, 3)[:, 2]
            rotations = self.data.geom_xmat[self.sample_geoms].reshape(-1, 3, 3)
            points = np.einsum('nij,nj->ni', rotations, self.samples)+self.data.geom_xpos[self.sample_geoms]
            separation = np.abs(points[:,None,:]-panel_positions[None,:,:])-panel_sizes[None,:,:]
            distances = np.linalg.norm(np.maximum(separation,0),axis=2)+np.minimum(np.max(separation,axis=2),0)-self.radii[:,None]
            closest = np.minimum.reduceat(distances, self.sample_starts, axis=0)
            collision = np.maximum(required_clearance[None,:]-closest,0).ravel()
            internal = np.zeros(len(self.moving))
            for contact in self.data.contact:
                if contact.geom1 not in self.shelf_set and contact.geom2 not in self.shelf_set:
                    for geom in [contact.geom1,contact.geom2]:
                        if geom in self.moving_set:
                            slot = self.moving.index(geom)
                            internal[slot] = max(internal[slot],-contact.dist-.003)
            ground = np.maximum(.025-np.minimum.reduceat(points[:,2]-self.radii,self.sample_starts),0)
            center = self.data.subtree_com[self.base_body] - self.data.xpos[self.base_body]
            balance = np.r_[np.maximum(np.abs(center[:2]) - [.145, .16], 0),.25*max(abs(center[0])/.203+abs(center[1])/.25-.78,0)]
            return np.r_[25*(position-desired), .15*(normal-[1, 0, 0]), 60*collision, 60*internal, 40*ground, 8*balance, .018*(configuration[:count]-reference[:count]), .04*(configuration[count:]-reference[count:])]

        random = np.random.default_rng(seed)

INITIAL = {'panda':[0,-.785,0,-2.356,0,1.571,.785], 'ur5e':[-.83943,-1.22370,-1.33717,-1.07738,-3.03934,3.03382], 'xarm7':[-2.26731,-.62319,-.00416,.22692,.02608,2.72839,-.08641]}

def make_model(arm,payload):
    robot=ET.fromstring(build(arm,payload))
    compiler=robot.find('compiler')
    if arm=='panda':
        compiler.set('meshdir','/workspace/assets/franka_emika_panda/assets')
    scene=ET.parse('/workspace/scene.xml').getroot()
    for elem in scene.find('worldbody'):
        robot.find('worldbody').append(elem)
    model=mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_string(ET.tostring(robot,encoding='unicode'))
    data=mujoco.MjData(model)
    joint_ids=[model.actuator_trnid[index,0] for index in range(4,model.nu)]
    addresses=model.jnt_qposadr[joint_ids]
    data.qpos[addresses]=INITIAL[arm]
    data.ctrl[4:]=INITIAL[arm]
    mujoco.mj_forward(model,data)
    return model,data,joint_ids,addresses

def context_for(model,data,arm,target,payload):
    path=f'/workspace/test_{arm}_{os.getpid()}.mjb'
    mujoco.mj_saveModel(model,path)
    return dict(model_file=path,arm=arm,target=target,target_name='test',shelf_face_x=.4,payload_kg=payload,
                actuator_names=[model.actuator(index).name for index in range(model.nu)],

                qpos=data.qpos.tolist(),qvel=data.qvel.tolist(),ctrl=data.ctrl.tolist(),control_dt=.02,duration=30.,seed=0)

def trial(arm,target,payload=2,verbose=True,full=False):
    from controller import make_controller
    model,data,_,_=make_model(arm,payload)
    controller=make_controller()
    start=time.process_time()
    controller.reset(context_for(model,data,arm,target,payload),0)
    print('reset',arm,target,'cpu',time.process_time()-start,flush=True)
    shelf={index for index in range(model.ngeom) if model.geom(index).name.startswith('pod_')}
    ee=model.site('arm_attachment_site').id
    max_force=0.
    min_support=4
    held=0.
    longest_hold=0.
    best=100.
    support_gaps=np.zeros(4)
    longest_gaps=np.zeros(4)
    min_margin=100.
    min_hold_margin=100.
    max_tilt=0.
    floor=model.geom('floor').id
    corners=['FL','FR','RL','RR']
    for step in range(1500):
        obs=dict(time=data.time,qpos=data.qpos.tolist(),qvel=data.qvel.tolist(),ctrl=data.ctrl.tolist())
        data.ctrl[:]=controller.act(obs)
        for substep in range(10):
            mujoco.mj_step(model,data)
            for contact_index in range(data.ncon):
                contact=data.contact[contact_index]
                if contact.geom1 in shelf or contact.geom2 in shelf:
                    force=np.zeros(6)
                    mujoco.mj_contactForce(model,data,contact_index,force)
                    if force[0]>max_force:
                        max_force=force[0]
                        if max_force>2:
                            print('COLLISION',data.time,model.geom(contact.geom1).name,model.geom(contact.geom2).name, 'bodies',model.body(model.geom_bodyid[contact.geom1]).name,model.body(model.geom_bodyid[contact.geom2]).name,'pos',contact.pos,'force',max_force,flush=True)
        error=np.linalg.norm(data.site_xpos[ee]-target)
        best=min(best,error)
        supported=set()
        support_points=[]
        for contact_index in range(data.ncon):
            contact=data.contact[contact_index]
            if floor in [contact.geom1,contact.geom2]:
                other=contact.geom1 if contact.geom2==floor else contact.geom2
                name=model.geom(other).name
                if name.startswith('rollerg_'):
                    force=np.zeros(6)
                    mujoco.mj_contactForce(model,data,contact_index,force)
                    if force[0]>.5:
                        supported.add(corners.index(name.split('_')[1]))
                        support_points.append(contact.pos[:2].copy())
        support_gaps=np.array([0. if index in supported else support_gaps[index]+.02 for index in range(4)])

import mujoco,numpy as np
model=mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path('/workspace/scene.xml')
data=mujoco.MjData(model);mujoco.mj_forward(model,data)
low=np.full(3,np.inf); high=np.full(3,-np.inf)
for geom in range(model.ngeom):
    name=model.geom(geom).name
    if not (name.startswith(('profile_','hub_','rollerg_')) or name=='battery_geom'): continue
    rotation=data.geom_xmat[geom].reshape(3,3)
    size=model.geom_size[geom]
    kind=model.geom_type[geom]
    if kind==mujoco.mjtGeom.mjGEOM_BOX:
        extent=np.abs(rotation)@size
    elif kind==mujoco.mjtGeom.mjGEOM_CAPSULE:
        extent=np.abs(rotation[:,2])*size[1]+size[0]
    elif kind==mujoco.mjtGeom.mjGEOM_CYLINDER:
        extent=np.sqrt(rotation[:,0]**2+rotation[:,1]**2)*size[0]+np.abs(rotation[:,2])*size[1]
    else: raise RuntimeError(kind)
    low=np.minimum(low,data.geom_xpos[geom]-extent)
    high=np.maximum(high,data.geom_xpos[geom]+extent)
print('Chassis/battery/wheel footprint [m]:',(high-low)[:2])
print('Final submitted model compiles in MuJoCo',mujoco.__version__)
